messages.subject: Re: problem to upload my application to shinyapps.io
parts:
You appear to be attempting to connect to a local database (host="localhost").
There is no database running there on shinyapps.io.

http://docs.rstudio.com/shinyapps.io/applications.html#accessing-your-local-databases-from-shinyapps.io

Additionally, you do not want to include rsconnect calls within your application code itself. They are generally meant to be run in the R console locally.

All that said, I am unclear on what other graph you are referring to and whether you have this running locally or if it is only failing on shinyapps.io

If it is not working locally, I recommend asking a general Shiny question at the Community site
